releases.title: Sharp frames, themed previews
releases.summary: A pane can trade bytes back for a pixel-exact frame, Markdown and Mermaid previews open in the theme you are already in, the Command action shrinks without losing its target, and focused Android probes trust surfaces they have already proven.

features.title: Trade bytes back for a sharp pane
features.detail: Setting MUXR_GRAPHICS_HALVE=0 keeps the producer's own pixels, so a pane that renders at the phone's device size lands 1:1 again instead of being halved and scaled back up. The default is unchanged, so the saving stays until you opt out, and pointer mapping stays correct in both arms.

features.title: Previews follow the app theme
features.detail: Markdown and Mermaid preview surfaces take the active light or dark palette before their first paint, so opening a document no longer flashes the opposite theme.

features.title: A smaller Command action
features.detail: The oversized Command puck is now a compact ellipsis that keeps a 44dp draggable target, so it stops covering terminal output without becoming harder to hit.

features.title: Terminal scrolling settles sharp
features.detail: Scrolling stays coarse while output moves and a sharp frame is restored once it goes quiet. Tapping the terminal opens the keyboard by default, with a persistent quick action to turn that off.

fixes.title: A host outage no longer ends the terminal
fixes.detail: Terminal and reconnect ownership is hardened, so losing the connection recovers the channel instead of closing the session behind it. Graphics memory and retries are bounded rather than left to grow.

fixes.title: Mermaid keeps its styles safely
fixes.detail: A strict diagram-only sanitizer preserves safe Mermaid styles and labels without weakening the sanitization applied to user HTML and SVG.

fixes.title: Packaged previews cannot lag their source
fixes.detail: The offline attachment renderer is rebuilt during the Android preBuild step, so the packaged assets match the source they were built from byte for byte.

fixes.title: Focused probes trust proven surfaces
fixes.detail: A probe targets the clickable Files navigation control with bounded confirmation while the title churns, and accepts prior exact-host proof for document and terminal viewers once the root connection is proven. Tree connection, terminal identity, fresh attach, input, provenance, workload, capture and deadline checks stay fail-closed.

fixes.title: Usage counts what the transcripts hold
fixes.detail: Local transcript accounting is authoritative, deduplicated across sources and bounded; gaps are shown as gaps rather than dressed up as data.

verification.title: Focused Android document, tree and terminal probes
verification.detail: The focused document, tree and terminal probes pass with complete before, moving and settled crops, and a short Android Perfetto profile was captured alongside them.

verification.title: Markdown, Mermaid and Actions device QA
verification.detail: On the exact rebased release APK, Markdown and Mermaid pass in light and dark, OCR finds both expected labels in both themes, and no opposite-theme transition frame appears in either. A hostile fixture of broken, nested and encoded Mermaid labels renders as visible escaped text and stays inert. The Actions target, drag, open behaviour and labels pass through a focused native flow, and the packaged renderer matches its source byte for byte. The dark pass is a clean retry after the first attempt lost its recording process.

releases.summary: Notes for the already published 0.1.28 nightly: one iOS keyboard accessory instead of two, peer messages that say who sent them, readable New Chat controls, and release completion that waits for the public surfaces to agree.

features.title: See who sent a peer message

releases.title: Steadier terminals, honest usage
releases.summary: Terminal graphics settle sharp instead of flickering, a dropped host reconnects instead of ending your session, and Usage reports only what the transcripts actually show.

features.title: Keyboard on tap is optional
features.detail: Tapping the terminal no longer forces the keyboard open when you only wanted to read. The shortcut is a setting, and it stays hidden on web where it has no meaning.

features.title: Visual release notes
features.detail: Each app version now has one authored release entry that this screen renders directly, and that release preparation turns into an offline HTML report and a Markdown release body.

fixes.title: Terminal images settle sharp
fixes.detail: A pane keeps one resident full image, refines a frame once output goes quiet, re-arms fences it lost, and bounds retained bytes, so scrolling through graphics stops flickering between blurred and sharp frames.

fixes.title: A host outage no longer ends the terminal
fixes.detail: Losing the Herdr connection now recovers the terminal channel instead of closing the session behind it.

fixes.title: Changes and Tools read correctly
fixes.detail: An untracked file counts its lines as additions in Changes, and the plugin header's own back control returns where it says it does.

fixes.title: Usage counts what the transcripts hold
fixes.detail: Local transcript accounting is authoritative, deduplicated across OMP and Pi sources, and bounded; gaps are shown as gaps rather than dressed up as data.

verification.detail: No automated run is recorded for the source that carries these changes. The earlier local run was on a commit before this work landed, so it says nothing about what shipped here.

releases.title: Computers that work together
releases.summary: Authorize paired computers to read, watch, and prompt one another safely.

features.title: Cross-computer agent access
features.detail: Agents list sessions, read output and status, watch completion, and send prompts across allowed computers without shell or destructive access.

features.title: Saved computers in Settings
features.detail: Select paired computers in Settings and see saved computers immediately while live collaboration checks finish.

features.title: Compact public agent guide
features.detail: Load the compact public agent guide with muxr --skill, pull focused topics on demand, and read bounded host history with muxr diagnostics; setup and updates never rewrite agent instructions.

fixes.title: Voice stays on one machine
fixes.detail: Native realtime voice remains pinned to the machine running it while it works with allowed agents elsewhere.

knownLimits: This entry was written after the fact from the shipped release notes; no verification record was retained for it.

legacyEntries.title: Pairing that stays paired
legacyEntries.summary: QRs scan reliably, saved machines switch cleanly, and browser access survives refresh.
legacyEntries.markdown:
- Scan a four-margin terminal QR directly from Settings → Pair another machine, with manual entry beside it.
- See the active computer on Home and switch saved machines there; stale sessions and forgotten computers disappear immediately.
- Show the host's real platform and only launchable agents in the Home composer.
- Pair browsers from one short two-minute HTTPS link with host-enforced control or explicit view-only access.
- Wait for browser storage to commit before setup reports success, recover interrupted grant indexes, and show an explicit recovery screen instead of silently appearing unpaired.

legacyEntries.title: One tap, one destination
legacyEntries.summary: Pairing, Usage, machine details, and Preview lose their duplicate steps.
legacyEntries.markdown:
- Keep Scan QR and manual pairing separate; the manual screen now contains only the string field and Connect.
- Open the provider-tab Usage screen from one plain pill beside Machine.
- See the active transport, relay URL, and muxr CLI version in machine details.
- Preview only detected HTML frontends by page title and carry the paired relay through the tunnel.

legacyEntries.title: Pair without the payload
legacyEntries.summary: A short relay-qualified code replaces the giant native pairing string.
legacyEntries.markdown:
- Enter one short two-minute pairing string or scan the same value as a QR.
- Pair through LAN, Tailscale, Cloudflare, or a custom relay without a central discovery service.
- Pairing lookups are encrypted, single-use, and deleted after resolution; completed handoffs are deleted after grant delivery.

legacyEntries.title: Polish everywhere
legacyEntries.summary: A design-review pass plus simpler, fewer bundled plugins.
legacyEntries.markdown:
- Proper green/red diffs, theme-correct voice overlay, and press feedback across terminal, sheets, and plugin screens.
- Copy a link from recent terminal output in one tap from the Actions menu.
- Fewer, simpler bundled plugins: Code (files, changes, and history) and Status (usage and vitals).
- The read-only browser now shows audited read-only plugin screens like Usage and Files; bundled plugin permissions refresh once after this safety upgrade.
- The setup menu guides instead of dead-ending, pairing recovers from expired sessions, and the app names OMP correctly.

legacyEntries.title: Visual usage and steadier voice
legacyEntries.summary: Charts and progress in plugin screens, plus screen-off voice fixes.
legacyEntries.markdown:
- See today’s per-agent token activity as charts and Codex limits as progress rings on a native Usage screen.
- Build richer plugin screens with data-bound progress, responsive columns, and bounded bar/ring charts — the same public UI vocabulary every extension uses.
- Keep voice alive with the screen off: wake and Wi-Fi locks during calls, speaking counts as activity, and reconnects recover over long sessions.
- Plugin failures show one clean message instead of technical detail; Git history shows a friendly empty state when a session has no folder.

legacyEntries.title: Readable code and honest usage
legacyEntries.summary: Syntax-highlighted source and offline multi-agent activity.
legacyEntries.markdown:
- Read source with line numbers and consistent syntax highlighting across Files, Markdown, plugin screens, and diffs.
- Use the same bounded code and diff views from third-party plugins without HTML or native modules.
- See today’s local coding-agent activity through a pinned offline ccusage backend, alongside current Codex limits.
- Keep costs, prompts, model names, projects, and session details out of the Usage card.

legacyEntries.title: Shared relays and safer setup
legacyEntries.summary: Guided onboarding, machine-scoped VPS relays, and runtime agent discovery.
legacyEntries.markdown:
- Run `muxr` for a reviewed, Cancel-first setup and maintenance menu.
- Host one encrypted relay for several machines without copying relay-owner authority.
- Pair a read-only browser from a clickable HTTPS link with clear eight-hour expiry and recovery.
- Choose agents from the connected Herdr host and view safe coding-CLI usage status.

legacyEntries.title: muxr
legacyEntries.summary: A focused mobile control surface for coding agents running through Herdr.
legacyEntries.markdown:
- Watch sessions, terminals, changes, and attention state from your phone.
- Send keys, inspect attachments, and start agents in a selected workspace.
- Use provider-neutral realtime voice or fully local Whisper dictation.
